text: How do you know exactly what is running inside a bank?
prefix: How do you know exactly what is running inside a bank?

text: Picture a product that always runs whatever is newest.
prefix: Picture a product that always runs whatever is newest.

text: On Tuesday, a rebuild quietly pulls a newer version nobody tested.
prefix: On Tuesday, a rebuild quietly pulls a newer version nobody tested.

text: On Wednesday, someone rolls back, pulls the newest again, and gets the same broken build.
prefix: On Wednesday, someone rolls back, pulls the newest again, and gets the same broken build.

text: Then the bank's assessor asks: what exactly runs in your card zone, and what is inside it?
prefix: Then the bank's assessor asks: what exactly runs in your card zone, and what is inside it?

text: Nobody can answer.
prefix: Nobody can answer.

text: A moving name can never say what runs.
prefix: A moving name can never say what runs.

text: Think of a book.
prefix: Think of a book.

text: Its second edition never changes once it is printed.
prefix: Its second edition never changes once it is printed.

text: When you quote it, you say which edition you read, and anyone can find the same page.
prefix: When you quote it, you say which edition you read, and anyone can find the same page.

text: Releases work the same way.
prefix: Releases work the same way.

text: Each part of the system numbers its versions in three parts.
prefix: Each part of the system numbers its versions in three parts.

text: The first number grows when a change breaks something callers rely on.
prefix: The first number grows when a change breaks something callers rely on.

text: The second grows when something is added.
prefix: The second grows when something is added.

text: The third grows for a fix.
prefix: The third grows for a fix.

text: So the number alone tells you how careful to be.
prefix: So the number alone tells you how careful to be.

text: A release is one numbered version, made once, from one exact state of the code, and never changed after.
prefix: A release is one numbered version, made once, from one exact state of the code, and never changed after.

text: Everything is built from it, and published under its number.
prefix: Everything is built from it, and published under its number.

text: Each built piece carries a bill of materials: a list of every component inside it, each with its version.
prefix: Each built piece carries a bill of materials: a list of every component inside it, each with its version.

text: It also carries a record of how it was built.
prefix: It also carries a record of how it was built.

text: So the assessor's question has an answer, written on the piece itself.
prefix: So the assessor's question has an answer, written on the piece itself.

text: Every install pins its versions.
prefix: Every install pins its versions.

text: A pin is one line that names the exact release a product runs.
prefix: A pin is one line that names the exact release a product runs.

text: There is one line for the card zone, one for ecom, and one for the portals.
prefix: There is one line for the card zone, one for ecom, and one for the portals.

text: Every environment runs real releases, the laptop too.
prefix: Every environment runs real releases, the laptop too.

text: So what a builder tests is exactly what the bank runs.
prefix: So what a builder tests is exactly what the bank runs.

text: An upgrade is four steps.
prefix: An upgrade is four steps.

text: Back up.
prefix: Back up.

text: Change the pinned line.
prefix: Change the pinned line.

text: Deploy.
prefix: Deploy.

text: Check.
prefix: Check.

text: The card zone goes first, before ecom, which depends on it.
prefix: The card zone goes first, before ecom, which depends on it.

text: The release notes are read before starting: they say what changed, and whether a new value is needed.
prefix: The release notes are read before starting: they say what changed, and whether a new value is needed.

text: And the database only moves forward.
prefix: And the database only moves forward.

text: A release can change the shape of the database, but never steps it back.
prefix: A release can change the shape of the database, but never steps it back.

text: So rolling back across such a change means restoring the backup taken just before.
prefix: So rolling back across such a change means restoring the backup taken just before.

text: That is why the backup is always step one.
prefix: That is why the backup is always step one.

text: Let's watch the product.
prefix: Let's watch the product.

text: An operator plans an upgrade.
prefix: An operator plans an upgrade.

text: They look at the list of releases.
prefix: They look at the list of releases.

text: Each has a plain number and its notes.
prefix: Each has a plain number and its notes.

text: They choose the newest, and read its notes first.
prefix: They choose the newest, and read its notes first.

text: The notes say whether a breaking change is inside, and whether the installer will ask for a new value.
prefix: The notes say whether a breaking change is inside, and whether the installer will ask for a new value.

text: On the server, the operator takes the backup.
prefix: On the server, the operator takes the backup.

text: Then they change one line: the card zone's pinned release, from the old number to the new one.
prefix: Then they change one line: the card zone's pinned release, from the old number to the new one.

text: They deploy.
prefix: They deploy.

text: The services restart on the new release, in order.
prefix: The services restart on the new release, in order.

text: The health check runs: every service healthy.
prefix: The health check runs: every service healthy.

text: Only then do they do the same for ecom.
prefix: Only then do they do the same for ecom.

text: Later, the assessor asks again: what is inside the card zone?
prefix: Later, the assessor asks again: what is inside the card zone?

text: The operator opens the bill of materials of one of its pieces.
prefix: The operator opens the bill of materials of one of its pieces.

text: It lists every component inside, each with its version, and the count sits at the bottom: the answer to the question.
prefix: It lists every component inside, each with its version, and the count sits at the bottom: the answer to the question.

text: What does this protect?
prefix: What does this protect?

text: It protects the bank from surprises: nothing changes unless someone changes a pinned line.
prefix: It protects the bank from surprises: nothing changes unless someone changes a pinned line.

text: It protects a rollback, because an old release is still exactly what it was.
prefix: It protects a rollback, because an old release is still exactly what it was.

text: It protects the assessor's trust, because every piece can say what it contains.
prefix: It protects the assessor's trust, because every piece can say what it contains.

text: And it protects the data, because the backup always comes before the change.
prefix: And it protects the data, because the backup always comes before the change.
